stemMd: A switch is on exactly when the indicator is green. The indicator is not green. What must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The indicator will turn green in one minute.

explanationMd: “Exactly when” expresses an equivalence between on and green. If green is false, on must also be false. This determines the switch state but not the indicator’s particular alternative appearance.

distractorRationale.c: That would require a green indicator.
distractorRationale.b: Not green does not specify which alternative colour or state occurs.
